Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1118
Claimant:
Debra Ryan
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
June 10, 2024
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a rear-end collision at a signalled intersection. Claimant is
represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their office. Initial injury report notes a concussion.
June 12, 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the policy start.
August 24, 2024
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the accident occurred
as described. The other driver's account matches in every key detail.
September 13, 2024
Photographs of the rear bumper and tail lamp assebmly show damage that is mostly consistent with the reported
impact speed. A few old scratches on the left quarter panel may predate this crash and are noted for separate review.
October 20, 2024
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account of the collision was the same as in the first call and in the
written statement, with no changes to sequence or position of vehicles.
November 30, 2024
Medical records show the claimant's treatment followed a usual course for a concussion and eased off as symptoms
improved. No prior injury to the head or neck area is known from the records requested so far.
December 5, 2024
It is not yet clear whether the current symptoms are caused by this crash. Requested an independent medical review
and prior records from the claimant's primary care provider to clarify the link.
December 28, 2024
File is on hold pending the medical review and the response to the records request. Next review is scheduled once
those documents arrive, with counsel copied on the status update.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
